playbook.line: Then-and-now on a neighbourhood: old Cairo footage against the same street today, or 80s-styled apartment staging.
Era-matched cars — a 1985 model shot on period-graded film, engine sound over the era track.
Give it a rule anyone can copy in one take — "show your flat in 3 seconds", "guess the price".
Make it a test with a pass/fail — "name the engine from the sound", "0–100 blindfold guess".
The single highest-fit format you have. Shoot every handover in the same frame twice, months apart.
